$comment: Deliberately outside the per-locale namespace scheme: this banner speaks the language the visitor is NOT currently reading, so all locales ship together in one small file rather than loading seven message bundles. Excluded from the parity guard for the same reason (scripts/i18n/lib.mjs walks directories only).
